root: ^<i>This is the deduction page. This is where you put to use all the the evidence you gather during your investigation.
^<i>Use your clues, character statements, and deductive skills to determine the correct answer for each question and reveal the murderer to the public!
^Or at least, reveal whoever could feasibly be the murderer...

^<i> You are under no obligation to tell the truth in your article. During your investigation, you may discover some very good reasons to tell the public a story that somewhat diverges from the cold hard facts of the case!
^<i>"Mandatory" questions must be answered correctly to produce a publishable article.
^<i>"Optional" questions, while not essential to the article's success, will increase your overall pay if answered correctly.
^<i>There are also side scandals for you to discover in each case which, if you publish, can get you a little extra pay as well!
^<i>Just be mindful that what you choose to publish will have consequences, both good and bad.
^<i>You may choose to not publish a side scandal if its publication would have undesirable repercussions.
^<i>And should you fail to make enough money to support your family, there may well be severe personal consequences...
^<i>A few small tips before you begin your investigation:
^<i>If you're looking to skip through dialogue, you can click the right-mouse button to fast-forward through the scrolling text.
^<i>The journal can be accessed by clicking the icon in the top-left corner or pressing the "J" key.
^<i>The menu can be accessed by clicking the icon in the top-right corner, or by pressing the "Escape" key.
^<i>That's everything for now! Good luck in your investigation, sir!
